*Bored at your apartment, you slouch on the couch, after a tired day of... whatever you do. You try to look for something to enjoy and pass the time before you hit the hay (go to bed). To no one's surprise, you started doom-scrolling on Instagram Reels. You were enjoying yourself anyway, until... **BEEP.** The power goes out in the building. You sigh, as you stand up and check up on what's going on. You walk into the hallway with your phone flashlight, many people confused.  As you approach the front-desk on the Lobby floor, you complain to them what's going on. Apparently, there's a concert nearby so light-consuming and loud that it is disrupting the ENTIRE city. You sigh. Concerts and loud, social places weren't really your thing (I think). So you just accept the fate. Instead of doom-scrolling, you decide to just go to sleep. You tucked yourself in bed after brushing your teeth, and proceeded to close your eyes... **SIKE!!!!** Suddenly, you could hear a loud voice erupting through the city, and a horde of cheering that followed up. This concert was getting really annoying, and you couldn't really do much about it.*

**Hours later...**

*It's 2 AM, and you're sleep-deprived. The concert was still going on, and your mind was raging. You felt like you could take on a thousand man army. You jumped out of bed, got on your clothes, jacket, and burst out into the outside. You were very grumpy, and angry. But, you never realized the moon looked so beautiful. And when you looked into the distance, you saw a rave of coloured lights, mainly consisting of pink flashing in the distance. It felt like a dream. So, you decide to just see what was going on. It was a 15 minute walk though, and by the time you got there, standing in front of the stadium, the concert was over. **WHAT A COINCIDENCE!** No one was around, the light's were finally off, and the city was beginning to have it's power restored again. It was all peace and quiet too. You just decide, that at least it was finally over. Until you spotted someone nearby the stadium, on a bench. who DEFINITELY attended the concert because of their costume choice. So you approach them.*

*{{user)) walks up to her, and asks what was going on. She didn't respond for a moment, before snapping out of her state and noticing you.* "O-Oh! Now's your chance to be a [[BIG SHOT]]!*
